text: player
I see it... I'm at the parade.

While people play the gongs and suona, the tall and majestic deity puppets move slowly through the noisy crowd. At the end of the lion dance and dragon dance teams is a four-to-five-story high tower made out of special long swords.

A-Yuan climbs nimbly up the rocks amid the crowd's cheering and sits on the blade at the top, then she throws millet, which is a symbol of auspiciousness, to the crowd below to bestow auspiciousness on them.
So this is the famous Mountain of Blades and Sea of Fire of the Nanxiang parade.
While I watch with great interest, A-Yuan suddenly appears next to me and points at a blazing fire in front of us.
A-Yuan
{var:player_nickname}... you're up now...
No! I don't want to jump over a fire pit!
Phew! I was just dreaming. I knew I shouldn't have read so many articles written by Chihori Terasaki.
Oh, A-Yuan is calling me. It's still so early--could something have happened?
Hello?
Hehe, I had a feeling you would be awake. Did you have a good dream? Did it have anything to do with me?
...I guess you can say that.
That dream was neither good nor bad. Although it gave me a fright, I find myself looking forward to the real parade even more than before.
Wow, my prediction was right. I sure am amazing. The ancestors must have secretly given me some hints.
Anyway, let's talk about your dream after we meet up. I'm calling you to tell you about some things you need to look out for today.
Things to look out for?
I have a strong premonition about this today, so you must remember three things when you come.
First, dress lightly. Second, don't wear new clothes. Third, don't wear flip-flops.
Oh! The delivery person is here. I'm going to hang up now. Don't forget what I said.
Although I don't understand why she told me those things, I should be okay if I follow the Nanxiang customs, right?
The ritual will be held again today, and I come to the Ancestral Hall early with Hua Yubai and Hua Yuqing.
Ancestral Hall
Auspicious hour of fortunate day! With deep respect, we humbly pray... In fair array, our ancestors appear; Their fragrance fills the hall, far and near--

In front of the crowd, A-Yuan sings an ancient song while wearing a simple and primitive mask, communicating with the ancestors with her unique dance. The raw, untamed energy of her movements still leaves me in awe, even though this isn't my first time seeing it...
Hua Yubai
So this is the Nuo dance.
Nuo?
Yes, the parade culture of Nanxiang originated from Nuo, the earliest worship of deities in the east.

This is an ancient culture of believing in the power of nature, which is manifested in the form of shamanic rituals. Later it developed into special Nuo operas and Nuo dances. Essentially, traces of the Nuo culture can be found in all folk cultures of the entire eastern land.

Our local opera culture, Nanxiang's unique parade culture, and the puppet show culture of the southeast all originated from Nuo culture, which means their culture, knowledge, and skills all share commonalities.
(whisper) Aha... I think I know how to adapt the opera now.
While we converse, A-Yuan stops dancing in front of me and speaks to me in a slow and ethereal voice from behind the mask.
Please follow me.
Hua Yuqing
Wow, you're so lucky, {var:player_nickname}! What are you waiting for? You've been selected to invite the ancestors!
Hua Yuqing looks at me with undisguised envy, while Hua Yubai smiles at me and nods encouragingly.

Under the scorching gaze of the crowd, I step out of the crowd despite the pressure and follow A-Yuan to the altar. After worshiping deities of heaven, earth, and the four cardinal directions, A-Yuan takes the Jiaobei from a wooden box and holds them in front of me with both hands.

{var:player_nickname}, this is the Jiaobei, a medium used to communicate with the ancestors. Please hold them and sincerely invite the ancestors to visit One Han City during Bamboo Cloud's anniversary celebration in your heart before throwing them into the air.
If one lands with the flat side up and the other lands with the round side up, this is the Sheng, which means the ancestors have accepted your invitation.
If both land with the flat side up, this is the Xiao, which means the ancestors are still considering your invitation and you can ask them again.
If both land with the round side up, this is the Yin, which means the ancestors have rejected your invitation. The ritual will fail if this happens three times.
Do you understand?
I understand.
Can you say that again?
Okay, I understand.

I pick up the Jiaobei, which feel really heavy to me with the crowd staring eagerly at me. For the first time in my life, I understand what it feels like to bear the hope of the entire city on my shoulders.
Huff... Let's start.
Unfortunately, life almost never goes your way, and my first two throws are Yin answers. I calm down before making my third throw.
Sheng: one has landed with the flat side up and the other has landed with the round side up. The ancestors accept your invitation.
Yin: both have landed with the round side up. The ancestors reject your invitation.
Xiao: both have landed with the flat side up. The ancestors are still considering your invitation.
The Jiaobei fall to the ground. It is another Yin answer.
I become extremely depressed as everyone around me starts sighing.
...I'm sorry, A-Yuan.
Don't be... It looks like I'll need to use my last resort. This doesn't happen very often.
Hmm?
Please give me a moment.
A-Yuan walks to the rear courtyard of the Ancestral Hall and returns to the altar with a black jar that looks really heavy.
After ripping off the seal...
Mr. Li
This is... Nanxiang's special chili sauce! It smells so authentic!
This is my only jar. Almighty ancestors... please accept this offering!
After speaking, A-Yuan signals for the musicians to start playing the ancient music again, then she also wears her mask and starts to dance again.
This time, amid the strong aroma of chili peppers, the person she selects manages to invite the ancestors successfully...

Sigh, I had a feeling this might happen, but I didn't think the ancestors really would refuse to come because the sacrificial offerings didn't have the right taste. From now on, I'm going to trust my intuition more.
...Is this even possible?!
Just like this, the difficult task of inviting the ancestors was completed in a way nobody expected...
The Jiaobei fall to the ground. It is a Sheng!
Crowd
It's a Sheng answer!
OOOHHH! The ancestors have agreed! It's a Sheng answer!
It worked... Argh! Hua Yuqing, what are you doing?
Don't move!
Hua Yuqing rushes over and grabs my hand, then she closes her eyes devoutly and mumbles something. Listening carefully, I hear her say--
Blessings and fortune, bring me good luck and wealth...
Hey! This is my hand, not a good luck charm that can make your wishes come true!
Excuse me... can I shake your hand?
Um... okay then.

Wow! Thank you so much! With your blessing, my Nanxiang Beef Noodle Restaurant will definitely surpass Bamboo Cloud's roast goose and take first place in the Champion Street Food Recommendation rankings this year.
Employee
Surpass the roast goose!
Person A
Please shake my hand too!
Person B
I want to touch the lucky hand too!
Um... o-okay... w-wait... stop tugging... ARGH! HELP...
Everyone...
The ancestors accepted the invitation because they approved of the relationship between {var:player_nickname} and us. It had nothing to do with luck.
You're right. Um, Miss A-Yuan... I'm sorry I was rude to you earlier. Please forgive me.
Of course, it's not a big deal. We all want the parade to go well.
Haha, alright! I'll give you and the supervisor a 20% discount whenever you come to my restaurant.
Come to my store! I'll give you a buy-one-get-one-free deal!
I'll give you a VVVIP card! I can help you with anything!
Thanks, everyone...
The people of Champion Street are all so honest and enthusiastic...
I can make your food extra spicy for free, too! Experience the taste of Authentic Nanxiang spiciness! I won't charge you if it isn't spicy enough to make you cry!
Wow, thanks!
Huh? That doesn't seem necessary!
The Jiaobei fall to the ground. It is a Xiao!
The ancestors have softened their stance. Try again to see if they will accept your invitation!
After the lively ritual ends, everyone leaves with high expectations for the parade.
{var:player_nickname}.
Hmm?
I need your help with something.

Now that the ritual has been completed successfully, everyone will start rehearsing for the parade. However, both the group in charge of carrying deity puppets and the group in charge of performing the Nuo opera on the day of the parade need more helpers.
{var:player_nickname}, can you pick one group to help?
I see... You don't need to ask me twice.
Help the group in charge of carrying deity puppets
Help the group in charge of performing the Nuo opera
I'll help carry the deity puppets.
Great! Please follow me.

A-Yuan takes me to wash my hands and burn incense before guiding me to a deity puppet. This deity puppet is one meter tall, and has a wooden head, bamboo frame, and gorgeous outfit befitting its identity.
When you were repairing the deity puppets, you learned that deity puppet carriers need to lift up a deity puppet from inside its frame to complete the parade along Champion Street.
But it's not that easy. It isn't enough to just lift it up and move around. You'll need to learn how to keep it balanced and make lifelike movements to interact with the public.
Following A-Yuan's instructions, I keep practicing the steps she teaches me...
One, two, three, four... Two, two, three, four...
Huff... Puff...
The sky was black, the earth was yellow, and the universe was vast and boundless...
...Who's that?

Upon hearing the sound of a bell tolling, I open my eyes to see an old man waving at me from a distance. The man looks very dignified and even a little familiar... Instinctively, I start walking toward him even though my legs feel incredibly heavy...
Someone catches me just as I start toppling over in my dazed state.
{var:player_nickname}!
I regain my senses as fresh air rushes all over me. Upon opening my eyes, I see that A-Yuan has helped me out of the deity puppet.
{var:player_nickname}, are you okay? Drink some water.
Thanks... I... think I just saw an ancestor...
Haha!
Why are you laughing?
You didn't see an ancestor. You had a heatstroke.
Huh?
If I knew you would have a heatstroke so easily, I would have reminded you to wear even less clothing.
Oh, so the reason you told me to dress lightly in the morning was because you were worried I would get heatstroke?

Yes, I had a feeling the ritual would succeed today, which means we would need to start rehearsing as soon as possible. Since you would probably help out, {var:player_nickname}... it would be very likely that you'll get heatstroke.
I glance at the tall and airtight deity puppet next to me... Yeah, it's quite easy to get heatstroke inside of that alright...
Why did you tell me not to wear new clothes then?
The frame of a deity puppet is made out of bamboo. If you wear new clothes while carrying it, your clothes will get dirty and might even be damaged. That would be a pity.
Then... what about not wearing flip-flops?
Because I didn't want you to sprain your ankle while rehearsing. Oh, remember to wear sports shoes on the day of the parade because you have quite a distance to cover.
...Okay, one last question!
Why did you ask me to wait for the incense to finish burning before I start rehearsing?
To prevent fires and eliminate fire hazards.
Everything is backed by science?!
What? Did you think these are all taboos? No wonder you have been so nervous since you threw the Jiaobei...
It's not as scary as you think. The ancestors are here to protect us, not to make things difficult for us. There aren't many things you need to be worried about as long as you respect them.
...I understand now.
If it's so easy to get heatstroke... what happens if a carrier gets heatstroke during the parade?

The organizers will plan the route in advance before the parade starts, and residents along the route will all place clean iced water at their doorsteps. They will also provide chairs for the carriers to sit on so they can rest at any time.
There's something more important than that of course.
A-Yuan looks at me, then she pats my shoulder and speaks sincerely.
The most important thing is that carriers must be physically strong and have a strong sense of conviction.
I understand why they need to be physically strong, but what do you mean by a sense of conviction?
Hmm... give me a moment.
A-Yuan thinks for a moment before walking inside the hall. She then returns with an old book in her hand.
Here, take this. This sense of conviction... is a person's love for Nanxiang. This book contains many stories about Nanxiang. I'm sure you'll fall in love with Nanxiang once you learn more about it.
Thanks, I'll take good care of this book.
Obtained Memento: Ancient Nanxiang Book
This way, this way! Put that over there! Be careful!
Suddenly, some lively shouts from the front yard of the Ancestral Hall catch our attention. A-Yuan takes my hand and leads me to the front yard.

Many workers who are usually busy working in restaurants are entering the Ancestral Hall. The lively discussions carried out in the local dialect and the sounds of gongs and drums fill the mysterious and empty Ancestral Hall with life.
Miss A-Yuan, are you here? Everyone has come for the rehearsals after getting off work!
Hey, I call dibs on setting off fireworks along the route! I promised my daughter that I would set them off for her!
Xiaoyun
Um... Miss A-Yuan, now that the deity puppets have been repaired, do you think I can do the Nuo dance with you at the parade?
Of course.
Yay! I'll start preparing for it then! Thanks...
Looking at the scene in front of her, A-Yuan shows me the most relaxed smile I've seen in the last few days.
Thank you so much. I won't let Ms. Fuuka down now.
I receive a text message from Fuuka Minami.
Fuuka Minami
(Text Message) Well done.
Speak of the devil.
I show A-Yuan the text message, which brings a smile to her face.

Yes... although Ms. Fuuka didn't show up this time, I know that it's because it's inconvenient for her to get involved since she's the leader of Bamboo Cloud. She's always been the staunchest supporter of the parade and has never stopped believing in me.
She's the one who insisted on bringing me and the folk culture of Nanxiang to One Han City even though many people initially thought the parade was just a stupid superstitious activity.
Why did she insist on doing that at the cost of being criticized?
Ms. Fuuka said she wanted those who follow her to feel at home even when they are working in another land.
Fortunately, everything turned out the way she wanted, and the parade became more and more popular over time as Bamboo Cloud grew.
Now that everyone in One Han City knows a lot more about Nanxiang, the culture of Nanxiang has taken root in a larger world.
That's wonderful.
Looking at the bustling crowd, I see the deity puppet carriers rehearsing with their puppets and notice the puppet I helped to repair among the other puppets who are watching over everyone gently.
At this moment, I finally understand why everyone here at Champion Street takes the parade so seriously and wants it to be a great success.
The parade conveys people's happiness and wishes, allowing those far from home to feel the connection and encouragement from their homeland and transforming an ordinary land into a distant paradise.
I'll be a Nuo opera performer.
A-Yuan takes me to wash my hands and burn incense before guiding me to a room.

The Nuo opera is the most important performance of the parade as it is how we welcome and thank the ancestors for accepting our invitation to join us. It's also the oldest Nanxiang dance used to worship deities, drive away plagues and diseases, and pray for peace.
I'll be the lead dancer in this Nuo opera dance. {var:player_nickname}, as one of the dancers, you'll need to know some basic dance steps.

A-Yuan takes me inside a room in front of us. There are various masks in the room, all of the same style as the one she wore during the ritual. Some are fully painted, while others are only half painted.

These are the Nuo masks I've made, and they represent the spirits of various ancestors. In the Nuo culture, one can drive away evil spirits by dancing while wearing these masks, so all performers are required to wear them during Nuo opera performances.
Pick a mask you like.
After nodding, I inspect the masks carefully to choose one I like.
Hmm... You take this one.
A-Yuan looks at me in surprise after seeing the mask I picked.
Is there something wrong with this one?
No, it's just that I just made this mask.

I get my inspiration for Nuo masks from my dreams, and I've seen many deities and ancestors while communicating with that other world... This particular figure has only appeared once, so I don't know much about it.
But... maybe we'll get to know each other well after today.
Obtained Memento: Nuo Mask
After wearing the mask A-Yuan hands to me and burning incense devoutly in front of a statue, I start to learn the exciting dance steps.
Focus on the steps and the rhythm. Nuo is an ancient power...
When I open my eyes, I find myself lying on the ground. A-Yuan helps me up, then she takes off my mask and fans me.
Are you okay?
A-Yuan, I think I just saw an... ancestor.
Haha... You just had a heatstroke.
...Heatstroke?
A-Yuan's words immediately bring me back to my senses.
Well, these masks are airtight and it's midsummer, which means it's really easy for performers to get heatstroke during a Nuo opera performance. Here, have some water.
If I knew you would have a heatstroke so easily, I would have reminded you to wear even less clothing when you were coming.
Oh, so the reason you told me to dress lightly, not wear new clothes, and not wear flip-flops in the morning was because you were worried I would get heatstroke?
That's not the only reason.
I knew it! There really are metaphysical elements involved!
I told you to not wear new clothes because you'll sweat a lot and soil them while practicing. I told you to not wear flip-flops because you might sprain your ankle if you wear them.
...Everything is backed by science?!
Why are you so surprised? Did you think these are all taboos? No wonder you were so nervous earlier.
The ancestors are here to protect us, not to make things difficult for us. There aren't many things you need to be worried about as long as you respect them.
...Okay, one last question!
Why did you ask me to wait for the incense to finish burning before I start rehearsing?
It's naturally to prevent fires and eliminate fire hazards.
Suddenly, some lively shouts from the front yard of the Ancestral Hall catch our attention. A-Yuan takes my hand and leads me to the front yard.
Um... Miss A-Yuan, now that the deity puppets have been repaired, do you think I can do the Nuo dance with you at the parade?
Of course.
Yay! I'll start preparing for it then! Thanks...

Yes... although Ms. Fuuka didn't show up this time, I know that it's because it's inconvenient for her to get involved since she's the leader of Bamboo Cloud. She's always been the staunchest supporter of the parade and has never stopped believing in me.
She's the one who insisted on bringing me and the folk culture of Nanxiang to One Han City even though many people initially thought the parade was just a stupid superstitious activity.
Looking at the bustling crowd, I see the deity puppet carriers rehearsing with their puppets and notice the puppet I helped to repair among the other puppets who are watching over everyone gently.
The parade conveys people's happiness and wishes, allowing those far from home to feel the connection and encouragement from their homeland and transforming an ordinary land into a distant paradise.
